name: dial-mpc-paper
title: Full-Order Sampling-Based MPC for Torque-Level Locomotion Control via Diffusion-Style Annealing
notes: Source: arXiv:2409.15610v1 (9 pages). Authors: Haoru Xue, Chaoyi Pan, Zeji Yi, Guannan Qu, Guanya Shi. External metadata not printed in this PDF: the paper was later published at ICRA 2025; the conversion used the user's copy of the PDF after reader highlights were removed (text unchanged).

Mathematics is transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' arXiv TeX source and checked against the PDF; equation numbers are given as \tag{...}. Authors' typos are kept as printed (for example 'horizion', 'convolusion', 'kernal', 'Quadraped').
Algorithm 1 is kept as an image and followed by a text transcription; its inner loop is printed as 'for i = 1 to N' although the text anneals from i = N down to 1.
Subsection letters repeat: A, B, C in Sections II, III and IV, and A, B in the Appendix. Most cross-references are printed in lower case ('fig. 2', 'section III-A', 'table I').

Table IV has merged parent headers; they are repeated in the column names ('Walking and Tracking: DIAL-MPC', ...). Text inside figures (axis labels, legends, time stamps) exists only in the image crops.

Floats are placed at paragraph boundaries near their printed position, so a figure or table can sit in a neighbouring subsection of the one that discusses it (for example Table III after the start of V. CONCLUSION, Fig. 7 in IV-B); search for 'Fig. N' or 'TABLE N' to find it. Footnote texts follow the paragraph of their column, which can be in the next subsection. Typography that is not carried over: bold DIAL-MPC rows in Tables I-III, the rule separating the real-world row of Table III, underlined acronym letters on page 1, italic 'Proposition'/'Proof' labels (bold here).
